Metadata.title: Relay AI
Metadata.description: Answers first. Humans when it matters. A support chatbot for small web shops.

Home.title: Answers first. Humans when it matters.
Home.lead: Add your FAQ, paste one line of code on your shop, and your visitors get instant answers. When the bot doesn't know, the chat comes to you.

preview.label: Example conversation
preview.visitor: How long do I have to return shoes?
preview.bot: You can return unworn shoes within 14 days of delivery. The return label is in your parcel.

Footer.note: Portfolio project. Runs on free tiers, with no real charges.

rule.title: How the bot decides
rule.body: It answers from the top match when similarity is at least {threshold}, or at least {corroborated} when half or more of the question's keywords also appear in that FAQ. Ranking: {ranking}.

Actions.title: Actions
Actions.subtitle: Things your bot can do for a visitor, not just answer. Every action asks the visitor to confirm before it runs.

descriptions.order_status: Asks for the order number and email, then looks the order up. Shows nothing unless both match.
descriptions.create_ticket: Collects a subject, details and an optional email, then creates a ticket and emails you through n8n.

Actions.demoOnly: Available only for the demo store's bot, because it reads the demo orders.

errors.demoOnly: Order status is available only for the demo store's bot.
errors.generic: Couldn't save that. Please try again.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.empty: No actions have run yet. Switch one on and try it in your widget.

Events.title: Event log
Events.subtitle: Everything your bots sent to n8n: emails to you and your visitors, and action calls. Message contents aren't shown here.

mode.simulated: Simulated mode: n8n isn't connected here, so nothing is emailed. Events are recorded as what would have been sent, and actions are computed in the app.
mode.real: Connected to n8n: events go to your workflows, and n8n reports back whether each email went out.

explain.queued: Waiting to be sent to n8n.
explain.retrying: n8n didn't accept it ({attempts} tries so far). Next try {next}.
explain.delivered: n8n accepted it and hasn't reported the result yet.
explain.simulatedEmail: Simulated: would have been emailed via n8n.
explain.simulatedAction: Simulated: computed in the app instead of n8n.

Events.empty: No events yet. They appear when a chat is handed to you, when you reply to a visitor who left, or when an action runs.
